notes.title: Perfect Golf Patch 1.4.2.4
notes.notes:
We are pleased to release another patch for Jack Nicklaus Perfect Golf.

This patch addresses the following issues

Bugs

Fixed No Reads on SkyTrak Launch Monitors
Fixed First Tee Mulligans so only available on Hole 1
Changed Dots on Swing Meter to make them more visible especially in sand
Added a console command to allow changing of the Wind Meter Color to make it more visible on cloudy days - game_windColor
Added code to support our new Mobile Game Companion App that will allow remote control of the game and show shot data for each shot.

Improvements

Added 1FT and 3FT gimmies

New Features

Added Drive Chip and Putt Challenge that uses the 2018 Rules for DCP
To play a DCP challenge use a course file specifically created for the challenge.  We have included a DrivePitch Course with this release.  Each of the nine holes represents one of the 9 shots required in DCP competition

notes.title: Perfect Golf 1.4.2.0 For Release Thursday December 8th Evening EST
notes.notes:
Here is a list of the functionality and improvements that have made it into this release. 

[h1]New Real Course Release - Kissing Tree in Texas[/h1]

We have released a new official FREE real course in Texas called Kissing Tree.  Built as a fun to play resort course it offers a number of risk and reward holes as is great fun to play.
 
http://kissingtree.com/blog/thrive/golf-chat-kissing-tree-course-architect-gary-stephenson/
 
[h1]Recorded Rounds, Compete Against Friends and Save Shots[/h1]
 
 
Under the solo game type you will now see 4 tabs: Local Recorded rounds, Friends Recorded Rounds, Saved Shots and Create New Game. 
 
Recorded Rounds.  Players can now select to record their round either locally to their hard drive or to both hard drive and the PG cloud making them available to their Steam friends. The friend rounds tab contains the 20 most recent rounds recorded by friends.
 
[h1]Saved Shots.  Players can now save shots to their local hard drive for replaying later.[/h1]  
 
You can lock a recorded round which means that when playing against that round, you must play at the same level and from the same tees .  If the round is not locked you can force the game to use the same tees as the recorded round by selecting ‘match tees’ in the pre round screen.
 
To save time on loading, Solo Play saved rounds and recorded rounds are only updated on game start.
 
  
 
[h1]Physics improvements[/h1]
 
 
As Perfect Golf is now compatible with a much larger selection of Launch monitors this seemed like an ideal time to cross reference our numbers for ball flight and reaction on landing with direct comparisons to real shots in a much wider selection of scenarios. This meant that we could for the first time, gather and compare shot data from a myriad of short shots and bunker shots which had not been possible before. It also meant that using a large number of real golfers hitting real shots in full size simulators, we could really start to fine tune the ball flight and ball reaction on landing on a much wider range of shots.
 
 
After comparing the data we made some changes to the physics calculations which brought PerfectGolf even closer reality meaning that a player’s creativity could be rewarded while at the same time reducing the number of ‘go to’ shot’s that people had become reliant upon in almost all scenarios (such as the very high spinning pitch).
 
 
Further to this, another goal was to blur the lines between the different shot types in the ‘scoring zone’ ie a part ‘Full shot’ swing, the pitch, lob shot and chip. Rather than having one basic shot that would fit the bill for a certain distance and lie, now the player has the opportunity to create realistic bump and run shots from off the green due to our improved fairway physics or they can play a 3/4 Lob wedge and spin it out close to the hole. Another option is to pitch it and have the ball grab and release or lob the ball up high from short ranges without having the unrealistic ability to constantly stop the ball on a dime. We have Increased the amount of power that can be accessed when chipping which helps when playing those bump and runs around the green.
 
 
Bunker shots have also received some physics love and now the ball behaves more realistically on shots where the ball is caught slightly fat or thin on levels above Amateur.
 
We have separated out Fairway firmness from Green Firmness allowing for a greater variety of game play settings and shot results so for example you can now play with normal fairways and soft greens if you choose to. 
 
 
[h1]Green Surface Options[/h1]
 
 
We have added two new settings to the putting options when creating a game. Previously in all golf games and even in PerfectGolf, the greens have always been, well...Perfect! This is quite obviously not the case IRL and even the greens on the PGA tour have small imperfections which can cause the ball to move slightly offline (or even back online as the case may be!) Using robot putting devices the ball can miss the hole between 1 and 2 times on even a perfectly hit straight 10 foot putt and so again in our search for golf sim perfection we have added this as an option to the game. You now have 3 green settings to choose from:
 
 
Perfect - defaults to this green type which is the same as before and is billiard table smooth
Realistic - behaves very similar to a PGA tour green
Bumpy - Slightly less manicured courses or courses where the weather often stops the green surfaces from being as smooth ie. Links courses.
 
[h1]Enhanced Cup Physics[/h1]
 
The ball/cup physics has been improved so that the ‘vacuum’ cup bug of the past few builds which enabled players to ram the ball into the hole at high speeds when putting has been eliminated. You will now have be more accurate with your line and your pace too as many of the putts that would previously been ‘sucked’ into the hole will now lip out if offline or jump out if struck too firmly. 
 
Three new Putting mode cameras have been added, designed to make it easier to play real time swing modes where putter movement is now more visible.  These can be selected in the settings menu and you can also toggle through them using the camera toggle key or ‘Dpad left’ function on the controller when on the green.

At first this change will make putting seem more difficult but once you realign yourself to the new pace requirements, things will become much easier. Overhitting putts which used to work well will now likely result in a lot of lipouts or the ball jumping over the hole. A little bit of practice will help here until you get a feel for the new physics
 
 [h1]Swing Method Balancing[/h1]

In conjunction with the enhanced cup physics which have made putting a little more difficult we have adjusted and balanced the skill / swing types:

3 Click: We have tweaked a few of the difficulty settings for various swing types. 3C has had the long game balanced by reducing the spin axis (sidespin) penalty for missed ‘snaps’. This will enable the pro and tour pro players to miss the ‘snap’ slightly on purpose to help control the curve of the ball. Larger missed ‘snaps’ will also have less of an effect.


Motion swing and RTS-M: The effect of offline swing paths on putts has been reduced and also the tempo factor has been removed from putting on tour pro difficulty levels. The timing of full and part shots has been altered so that time spent in the ‘overswing’ area is now counted when calculating the tempo of the swing which makes over swung shots less difficult to time correctly.

The amount of the overswing penalty has been halved making it a more practical risk and reward

All swing types: Fine tuning of fat and thin shots for flop shots and bunker shots. Motion swing and RTS - M tempo, controller swing path and 3C snap penalties have all been tweaked for fat and thin shots.
 
[h1]Improved Wind[/h1]
 
 
Improved Wind effects on the ball in lower wind speeds and added the ability to change the wind in the game set up screen. It will default to your preferred setting in Weather Settings but you can now change it on a round by round basis.  
 
Restored the fluctuating wind meter on Pro and Tour Pro. We felt that it’s possible IRL to feel the wind changing as you plan your shot and it was unfair to hide this detailed information from the player at any level.
 
 We will be revisiting Wind again in a future release
------------------------
 
 
 
[h1]All new AI player Implementation and skills settings[/h1]
 
 
We have rewritten the AI code so that the golfers play much more like a human player, are faster and a greater variety of different skill levels can be achieved.
 
The computer player skill level for a listed shot type affects how likely he is to be able to pick a good shot from all the choices available to him.
 
The Accuracy affects his ability to hit the snap on a particular shot he has chosen
 
The State of Mind affects whether his is always trying to hit the longest shot with a club he can and whether he sticks to the aim points planted on the course by the designer.  Aggressive players will overswing more.
 
The Skill level of the golfer (In Player Difficulty) will affect how much the missed snap affects the trajectory of the ball
 
 
 
[h1]New ‘in game’ Controller menu X Key [/h1]
 
 
We have an all new in game controller menu which can be accessed with the Blue X button.  This brings up a menu of several items that were previously difficult to access due to combinations of buttons on the controller.  Items such as the original settings menu, scorecard, leaderboard, spot pin, tend pin, move tee, drop and the practice options were all added to this menu
 

 
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
 
Bug fixes to several modes of play including matchplay bug where players still in hole could be ignored
 
Added 3 person points alt shot to list of mops for that time when you have 6 players
 
Fixed pin tending on Alt Shot
 
Fixed plugged lies on Alt Shot following the player instead of the shot resulting in people seeing plugged lies in the green or outside the bunker
 
Fixes to hazard golf.
 
Improvements to the Simulator Console App

Improvements to the tournament API to allow for scoring events like hazard golf and stableford to be played using the api

Pressing the left Stick (RH) while in drop mode will allow you to position the drop within the defined drop area
 
Many more minor bug fixes

[h1] Known Issues with this Release[/h1]

Sometimes the end game routing can take up to 45 seconds to complete expecially when using a controller.  This affects some poeple and not others.

Occasionally when playing against a recorded round some shots will be lost and you will see a post shot screen at which point they will be moved to their second shot without the first shot being played

Occasionally a computer player will encounter a situation he is unable to find a shot to play.  We have a timer that will reset him to have another attempt which runs after 60 seconds which cures 99% of these problems but there were a couple of occasions where beta testers had to resume in order to get him to hit out of hundreds of rounds played with the AI

Well we have continued to be hard at work on the next 1.4.2.0 update.  We have pushed the final version into beta with all the planned functionality and should be able to release as soon as we feel that any remaining critical bugs have been resolved.



Here is a list of the functionality and improvements that have made it into this release. 


Recorded Rounds, Compete Against Friends and Save Shots


Under the solo game type you will now see 4 tabs: Local Recorded rounds, Friends Recorded Rounds, Saved Shots and Create New Game. 

Recorded Rounds.  Players can now select to record their round either locally to their hard drive or to both hard drive and the PG cloud making them available to their Steam friends. The friend rounds tab contains the 20 most recent rounds recorded by friends.

Saved Shots.  Players can now save shots to their local hard drive for replaying later.  

You can lock a recorded round which means that when playing against that round, you must play at the same level and from the same tees .  If the round is not locked you can force the game to use the same tees as the recorded round by selecting ‘match tees’ in the pre round screen.

To save time on loading, Solo Play saved rounds and recorded rounds are only updated on game start.

  

Physics improvements


As Perfect Golf is now compatible with a much larger selection of Launch monitors this seemed like an ideal time to cross reference our numbers for ball flight and reaction on landing with direct comparisons to real shots in a much wider selection of scenarios. This meant that we could for the first time, gather and compare shot data from a myriad of short shots and bunker shots which had not been possible before. It also meant that using a large number of real golfers hitting real shots in full size simulators, we could really start to fine tune the ball flight and ball reaction on landing on a much wider range of shots.


After comparing the data we made some changes to the physics calculations which brought PerfectGolf even closer reality meaning that a player’s creativity could be rewarded while at the same time reducing the number of ‘go to’ shot’s that people had become reliant upon in almost all scenarios (such as the very high spinning pitch).


Further to this, another goal was to blur the lines between the different shot types in the ‘scoring zone’ ie a part ‘Full shot’ swing, the pitch, lob shot and chip. Rather than having one basic shot that would fit the bill for a certain distance and lie, now the player has the opportunity to create realistic bump and run shots from off the green due to our improved fairway physics or they can play a 3/4 Lob wedge and spin it out close to the hole. Another option is to pitch it and have the ball grab and release or lob the ball up high from short ranges without having the unrealistic ability to constantly stop the ball on a dime. We have Increased the amount of overswing power that can be accessed when chipping which helps when playing those bump and runs around the green.


Bunker shots have also received some physics love and now the ball behaves more realistically on shots where the ball is caught slightly fat or thin on levels above Amateur.

We have separated out Fairway firmness from Green Firmness allowing for a greater variety of game play settings and shot results so for example you can now play with normal fairways and soft greens if you choose to. 


Green Surface Options


We have added two new settings to the putting options when creating a game. Previously in all golf games and even in PerfectGolf, the greens have always been, well...Perfect! This is quite obviously not the case IRL and even the greens on the PGA tour have small imperfections which can cause the ball to move slightly offline (or even back online as the case may be!) Using robot putting devices the ball can miss the hole between 1 and 2 times on even a perfectly hit straight 10 foot putt and so again in our search for golf sim perfection we have added this as an option to the game. You now have 3 green settings to choose from:


Perfect - defaults to this green type which is the same as before and is billiard table smooth
Realistic - behaves very similar to a PGA tour green
Bumpy - Slightly less manicured courses or courses where the weather often stops the green surfaces from being as smooth ie. Links courses.

Enhanced Cup Physics

The ball/cup physics has been improved so that the ‘vacuum’ cup bug of the past few builds which enabled players to ram the ball into the hole at high speeds when putting has been eliminated. You will now have be more accurate with your line and your pace too as many of the putts that would previously been ‘sucked’ into the hole will now lip out if offline or jump out if struck too firmly. 

Three new Putting mode cameras have been added, designed to make it easier to play real time swing modes where putter movement is now more visible.  These can be selected in the settings menu and you can also toggle through them using the camera toggle key or ‘Dpad left’ function on the controller when on the green.



Improved Wind


Improved Wind effects on the ball in lower wind speeds and added the ability to change the wind in the game set up screen. It will default to your preferred setting in Weather Settings but you can now change it on a round by round basis.  

Restored the fluctuating wind meter on Pro and Tour Pro. We felt that it’s possible IRL to feel the wind changing as you plan your shot and it was unfair to hide this detailed information from the player at any level.


------------------------



All new AI player Implementation and skills settings


We have rewritten the AI code so that the golfers play much more like a human player, are faster and a greater variety of different skill levels can be achieved.

The computer player skill level for a listed shot type affects how likely he is to be able to pick a good shot from all the choices available to him.

The Accuracy affects his ability to hit the snap on a particular shot he has chosen

The State of Mind affects whether his is always trying to hit the longest shot with a club he can and whether he sticks to the aim points planted on the course by the designer.  Aggressive players will overswing more.

The Skill level of the golfer (In Player Difficulty) will affect how much the missed snap affects the trajectory of the ball



New ‘in game’ Controller menu


We have an all new in game controller menu which can be accessed with the Blue X button.  This brings up a menu of several items that were previously difficult to access due to combinations of buttons on the controller.  Items such as the original settings menu, scorecard, leaderboard, spot pin, tend pin, move tee, drop and the practice options were all added to this menu


Bug Fixes

Bug fixes to several modes of play including matchplay bug where players still in hole could be ignored

Added 3 person points alt shot to list of mops for that time when you have 6 players

Fixed pin tending on Alt Shot

Fixed plugged lies on Alt Shot following the player instead of the shot resulting in people seeing plugged lies in the green or outside the bunker

Fixes to hazard golf.

Improvements to the Simulator Console App

Many more minor bug fixes


Release of 1.4.2.0

Soon.... :)

notes.title: Perfect Golf 1.4.1.1 Patch Released
notes.notes:
The first patch to 1.4.1 is now out.  In this patch release are:
 
Updated Muirfield Course file with complete Clubhouse and revised course surrounds housing more in line with what is there for those that have purchased the course file

[h1]New Features[/h1]

Additional Anti Cheat features for zero axis controllers and large dead zone controllers on X axis and Mouse X Axis changes.  Work in Progress

A Drop Rehit option after you have selected continue on the post shot screen.  Right now it is only the option to Rehit.  For Mouse / Keyboard users you can use the new icon on the right hand side with a hand dropping a ball.  This can be used anytime after the post shot screen has closed to go back to your last shot with a stroke and distance penalty.  If you click it accidentially you can cancel.  On the controller you will need to hold in the left trigger and press the left bumper.

Added Hide UI to controllers using Pressed Left Trigger and Right Bumper

Added State of Mind for AI player which toggles between Controlled and Aggressive.  A controlled player will rarely overswing and will play to the aim points.  He will almost always choke down on a longer club than try to force a shorter club.  The aggressive player will try to drive as far as the hole allows and will usually try to force a shorter club.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

Greensomes Scoring fixes

AI Short Putting Improvements <3ft

Fix for sudden ball stop

Fixed XBOX One for Windows 10 Experience Update  impact on Xbox Controllers

Attempt to fix the sharp edges around the pin when planting difficult pins

Added Controller type to tournament API

Fixed a bug where very occasionally a green mesh would lose its collider

Fixed Scrolling issue in tournaments and multiplayer games

Fixed Stats not scrolling to second page

notes.title: Perfect Golf 1.4.1.0 Update and Royal Troon Release Later Today
notes.notes:
This release is a couple of minor bug fixes plus a complete rewrite of the Computer Players.  We have released this a little earlier than we planned due to the release of Royal Troon which requires an update to the game so that the Pot Bunkers will work.  We will continue to work on the Computer Players.

[h1]Computer AI Players[/h1]

The computer players have been significantly advanced but they still have a few issues we are working on. 

We have added an Accuracy Setting for computer players.  This setting determines how good they are at hitting the snap.  Set it to 10 and computer players will almost always hit the fairway even at Tour Pro.  Set it to 1 and they will miss a bunch of fairways at Am and Above.
 
The driving and long iron and short iron Skills determine how much of the snap error is taken on each shot
 
The Short Game and putting Skills define how many times the game will attempt to find the best shot honing in on it.  
 
You can change the skill of the computer player general difficulty so snap misses are proportional to that skill level.
 
These settings and the overall general difficulty level of the player will allow you to create and fine tune the experience.
 
We feel this is a major improvement to the computer players.  However I am sure as they get a good deal of use people will uncover situations where they make odd decisions. There are an infinite number of potential positions the computer golfer can get into including bad aim points on certain courses.  

Please report any strange decision making you get.

[h1]Royal Troon[/h1]
We have reached an agreement with Royal Troon to bring you an official version of this years British Open Course.  This will be available to purchase in the store very soon.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

Fix for move ball on tee after aim
Fix for tee not showing
Fix for ball not stopping and game freezing
Fix ball not bouncing on chip to uphill flat area resulting in too much speed retained on chip
 

[h1]New Features[/h1]

Added Individual Combine Challenge Mode MOP
Added International Stableford MOP to support community course release of Castle Pines
Added Altitude and Par to Course Name in Carousel

notes.title: Perfect Golf 1.3.9.3 Release Today Mar 30th
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the release of 1.3.9.3.  Included in this release are a variety of bug fixes and new features

[h1]New 32 and 64 bit versions of PG[/h1]
Now when you update PG if you have a 64bit machine it should download the 64bit version of the game
 
[h1]New Ball Roll Physics[/h1]
We have finally fixed the bug where the ball was not rotating at the same speed as the ball was moving.  We have also added a logo to the ball.
 
[h1]All New On Course Practice Mode[/h1]
We have finally added a new MOP called Practice( change Stroke, Match etc to PRactice).  In this mode you get two new buttons in the bottom left of the screen.  The Ball Icon once clicked will allow you to move the ball anywhere on the screen or even in the top view and your next shot will be from that position.  works just like the aim stick
In addition there is a practice icon which gives you the opportunity to go to any hole on the course or change the wind speed and direction
 
[h1]New Game Play Modes[/h1]
Greensomes MOP Added
2Man Scramble MOP Added
4Man Scramble MOP Added
 
[h1]New Features[/h1]
Added a Simulator offset to allow Sim users to not have the ball in the center of the screen -> sim_SideOffset can be set in console pre game.  + moves ball to left - to right of screen.
Added MatchPlay, and Team Events to the API Tournament Score Reporting
Added Display of all golfer balls on top view
Added a feature to allow non tournmanent players to play on a local game with a tournament player with only the tournament players scores being reported.  First player in game should report
Added elevation to the yardage listed beside players on the left
Modified the setting in Players for the auto green grid. You now have 3 options "Always On" , "Always Off" and "On Green Only"
Added Lie to Post Shot
 
Simulator Improvements (Please Note all simulation options may not work without appropriate beta access from Manufacturer)
Putting and Simulation Mode for Trackman 4 (WIP)
Putting for Skytrak has been toned down in terms of horizontal error
Added integration 
Split the Simulator UI Device selection out from main device leaving a generic sim device and sub devices
 
 
PLEASE NOTE ALL SIMULATOR FEATURES REQUIRE A SIMULATOR SUBSCRIPTION 

[h1]Other Items / Bug Fixes[/h1]
Improvements to network code
Improvements to memory usage
Made some improvements to the hole cup physics
Fixes to the cameras for stuck in pano modeFixes to the hole cup for ball falling through terrain into hole
Fix to scorecard not showing for all players at start of hole if selected in UI
Fix for PROS auto on when exiting RTS modes
Fix for TP more than 3 second putt
Fix for XBOX One Menu Button to go to settings
Fix for chat getting disabled in controller mode
Fix for Ani bones structure in lower quality settings
Fix for loss of aiming from time to time
Multiple imporvements to Computer Player
Fixed Custom Flag Sticks not showing in game
Moved Free camera on controller to DPAD Down
Moved Spot Pin on controller to Left Trigger + Dpad Down
Moved Scorecard / Leaderboard on controller to Left Trigger + Dpad Left
added an option to turn off the mouse scroll wheel changes club in game settings
Improved the First Install Graphics options for a better first time experience
Fix a bug in the reporting API which did not distinguish between a hole not played and a hole in one in nearest the pin tournaments.
Fixed As it Lies not showing as the first drop option
Fixed Tournament Scroll Bar
Fixed a bunch of Controller Navigation Bugs

notes.title: Perfect Golf 1.3.8.2 Patch Released
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce Perfect Golf 1.3.8.2 Patch.  Our next scheduled full release 1.3.9.0 will introduce the new animations into the game and will be released later this month. 

[h1]New Features and Improvements[/h1]

This patch contains a major upgrade to the swing meter which we felt had not received any attention since the early days of Early Access.  We wanted to find a way to present a more rhythmical swing while eliminating the need for different swing meters for short putts.  As a result we have moved the swing meter start position for 3 click from 6 o clock to 5 o clock which provides sufficient time to make a short putt click and also made the meter keep going past the initial click for a while before coming back down thus giving time to make subsequent clicks. 

This patch also intruduces the Free Camera into the game.  Fully integrated with Multiplayer,after you have hit your shot you can enter free cam mode to watch your opponent hit his shot from any angle or indeed go down to where your ball has landed and start planning your next shot.  As soon as it is your turn to hit again you just disengage the free camera and you will be returned to your regular playing position based on your camera selection.  To toggle the free camera in Mouse and Keyboard mode you use the F5 key (you can change this in input settings) and in controller mode you press both triggers and the right bumper button to engage and disengage free camera.  The free camera contains a small height indicator in the lower left of the screen. 

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

This patch also fixes the following bugs

Fixed more than 4 player alternate shot matches incorrectly selecting one player and advancing them to the end of hole on second hole

Caddie club selection when near green and in splash mode now selects correct club

Kicking the active player now works in the game as does kicking any player allowing the host to return to the game after kicking the player

Enabled Post Game chat while in scorecard, stats at the end of the round

Fixed the camera selection when using the C key resetting after aiming

Fixed the camera selection when using the C key affecting how you saw next player up

Fixed Scorecard for 3 person points which only showed 2 players

Fixed Blank Post Hole PopUp occuring on certain mops

Changed Delay on Post Hole Pop Up for non Hazard Golf events 

Fixed F2 Plus Aim, No Pros left you without a swingmeter

Fixed F2 Plus AimStick plus no aim plus F2 left you without a swingmeter

Added lie effects for simulator

Fixed the game controller losing focus at end of round

Fixed showing Stats incorrectly at end of game when playing Alt Shot

Fixed Camera going underground in Free Cam Mode

Made Free Camera Not reset when remote player aims

Made Amateur play like the old Hacker and made Hacker an intermediate step between beginner and Amateur (Note some of you may see your players get set to Custom as this change takes effect)

Fixed the shot shaper not getting reset

Added C and R text to club distance indicating carry or carry+roll distances

Fixed Black Screen when pressing A during a computer player shot

notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce Perfect Golf 1.3.8.2 Patch.  Our next scheduled full release 1.3.9.0 will introduce the new animations into the game and will be released later this month. 

[h1]New Features and Improvements[/h1]

This patch contains a major upgrade to the swing meter which we felt had not received any attention since the early days of Early Access.  We wanted to find a way to present a more rhythmical swing while eliminating the need for different swing meters for short putts.  As a result we have moved the swing meter start position for 3 click from 6 o clock to 5 o clock which provides sufficient time to make a short putt click and also made the meter keep going past the initial click for a while before coming back down thus giving time to make subsequent clicks. 

This patch also intruduces the Free Camera into the game.  Fully integrated with Multiplayer,after you have hit your shot you can enter free cam mode to watch your opponent hit his shot from any angle or indeed go down to where your ball has landed and start planning your next shot.  As soon as it is your turn to hit again you just disengage the free camera and you will be returned to your regular playing position based on your camera selection.  To toggle the free camera in Mouse and Keyboard mode you use the F5 key (you can change this in input settings) and in controller mode you press both triggers and the right bumper button to engage and disengage free camera.  The free camera contains a small height indicator in the lower left of the screen. 

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

This patch also fixes the following bugs

Fixed more than 4 player alternate shot matches incorrectly selecting one player and advancing them to the end of hole on second hole

Caddie club selection when near green and in splash mode now selects correct club

Kicking the active player now works in the game as does kicking any player allowing the host to return to the game after kicking the player

Enabled Post Game chat while in scorecard, stats at the end of the round

Fixed the camera selection when using the C key resetting after aiming

Fixed the camera selection when using the C key affecting how you saw next player up

Fixed Scorecard for 3 person points which only showed 2 players

Fixed Blank Post Hole PopUp occuring on certain mops

Changed Delay on Post Hole Pop Up for non Hazard Golf events 

Fixed F2 Plus Aim, No Pros left you without a swingmeter

Fixed F2 Plus AimStick plus no aim plus F2 left you without a swingmeter

Added lie effects for simulator

Fixed the game controller losing focus at end of round

Fixed showing Stats incorrectly at end of game when playing Alt Shot

Fixed Camera going underground in Free Cam Mode

Made Free Camera Not reset when remote player aims

Made Amateur play like the old Hacker and made Hacker an intermediate step between beginner and Amateur (Note some of you may see your players get set to Custom as this change takes effect)

Fixed the shot shaper not getting reset

Added C and R text to club distance indicating carry or carry+roll distances

Fixed Black Screen when pressing A during a computer player shot

notes.title: Perfect Golf 1.3.8.1 Patch Released
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce a patch release 1.3.8.1 to fix a number of bugs in the 1.3.8.0 Release

[h1]Course Updates[/h1]

We have updated the Illinois Golf Course to remove issues related to uneven terrain on the greens.

[h1]OS Specific Fixes[/h1]

Fixed Game UI failing to load when using OSX (Mac)
 
[h1]Improvements[/h1]

Made significant improvements to aiming with the controller.  The left stick Press now allows you to toggle between aiming in the main view, aiming in the top view and not aiming.  The A button allows you to set an aim based on the stick location in which ever view you are active.
 
Added messaging in the bottom right explaining when the swing meter was inactive which button to press to exit certain modes
 
Added a Pop Up message for certain MOP Events especially during hazard play rather than having them all write to the chat window.

Separated Controller Handedness from Player Handedness allowing you to use a right handed player in game with left handed controller set up.  Controller handedness set up can be changed in Player General Settings
 
Added Players Distance to Pin to the Top left Player menu in game so you can see everyone's current distance
 
[h1] General Bugs[/h1]

Fixed unable to resume or end a saved multiplayer session from the controller
 
Fixed Gimme and auto gimmie in alt shot double count... Gimmie now disabled in auto gimmie mode
 
Fixed Players can no longer change physics variables in the Console
 
Fixed a variety of situations where there was either no swing meter or aiming caused a black screen
 
Fixed a variety of situations where the camera would get stuck in Pano Mode 
 
Fixed a bug in simulator mode where putts would not take the launch direction value
 
Fixed a variety of animation issues on the Simulator
 
Fixed a bug where if the controller focus was on Start Game when the lst person clicked Ready the controller would lose focus

Fixed a bug where Multiplayer Chat would not work when playing passworded game
 
Fixed a variety of multiplayer bugs where Scorecard Settings / Grid Setting etc would default to the game HOST values in multiplayer games
 
Fixed a bug where the Controller could not scroll down to multiple Games or Tournaments
 
Fixed bug where Players ping no longer displayed in Multiplayer games
 
Fixed a bug which would cause othr players swing meter settings to show during multiplayer rounds
 
Fixed a bug where the User Interface covered password box on game connection
 
Fixed a bug where typing in chat activated input keys
 
Fixed a bug where Scorecard key would active scorecard but not close it again
 
Fixed a bug which prevented users from entering official tournaments
 
Fixed a bug where the slider sensitvity for controller was too low preventing certain settings from being used
 
Fixed a bug where the dynamic replay cam would not snap

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

Playing Alternate Shot with 3 or more teams leads to the game being unable to determine who is next to hit

Using the arrow keys or Controller Stick to free aim in multiplayer can cause slow aiming response times for clients connected to a host

Spacebar to hide golfer not working as intended

notes.title: Perfect Golf 1.3.8.0 Release Today
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that 1.3.8 has now been given a public release.
In this release are:

[h1]An All New Landing Page and UI Elements[/h1]

No longer will players be dumped straight into the Multiplayer page.  There is now a brand new home page with butons for the major activities and a news section and a Content Coming Soon section.  This will enable us to communicate directly with the players with key news items links to tutorials and other information

Tournaments have been given their own tab which is indicative on how we plan to move this section forward by providing people with ever increasing options to play in tournament mode.

Chat is now only visible in the Tournament and Multiplayer sections leaving a lot more room for a better game set up experience. Due to the lack of a keyboard Chat is disabled in Gamepad only mode although in game chat messages will still show up

Revamped in game leaderboards and scorecards.

An option to have the scorecard (or leaderboard if in tournament or challenge mode) show at the end of each hole automatically

[h1]Controller support[/h1]

This release introduces controller support for all facets of the game.  We still need to tie in the controller swing into the animation as we plan to do with the motion swing once the new animations are in. But the whole game can be played on the controller from setting up the game in the UI to playing it.

The controller can be selected under the Settings Input Tab.  

When this is selected the Controller Swing becomes available in the list of devices in game settings.

[b]To use the controller swing pull back on the stick and wait for the power to increase to your desired level.  Let go of the stick, then when the meter gets back to the snap area push it forward again.  The net direction of the movement will determine the direction of the ball and the accuracy of the snap will affect the center hit and power realised.[/b]
 
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed Alt Shot bug where a playoff would crash the game on end
[*] Fixed Grid balls rolling backwards and stopping
[*] Fixed tournament loophole where stopping a hole and restarting would not incur a penalty
[*] Added a Generic TCP IP Simulator Device to allow connections to the game from devices that support TCP IP communications
[*] Fixed fairway roll not dependent upon conditions (Hard or Soft)
[*] Made some changes to the chips 
[*] Fixed the odd ball bounces
[*] Hard and Soft Conditions revamp 
[*] Beginner Mode made easier 
[*] Fix to Pano and Player cam nodding down on shot start (still occurs on Follow Cam if you set follow distance to 0) 
[*] Added Pop Ups for various events like Concede, End Game and Quit so you cannot do these things by acident 
[*] Updates to Real Time Weather 
[*] Fixed Alt Shot Bug where auto gimmie and gimme added two shots 
[*] Made some changes to Night Time to allow golf to be played under moonlight 
[*] Big improvements to the reverse camera especially on shorter shots.
[*] Introoduced a delay on the swing meter when using pause render on swing to prevent swings starting before the render screen has finished resulting in a black screen 
[*] Minor impovements to Fog  
[*] Minor improvements to physics on downhil bounces
[*] Removed Spin Axis Center from Aids calculation enabling beginners to shape the ball 
[*] Doubled penalties for Driver off the deck shots
[*] Fixed bug where spelling was incorrect in players screen 
[*] Fixed bug where game information was misaligned or incomplete 
[*] Fixed bugs in adding and deleting players where default player would change 
[*] Added a resume button under game when going to settings in the game in addition to the arrow to return
[*] Changed Mulligan Default to OFF
[*] Fixed bug where using camera view could lose the swing meter if PROS was not enabled
[*] Fixed problem in practice mode where you could not see your shot data as the swing meter disappeared as soon as you hit the shot.
[*] Fixed bug where game would go into pano mode following a drop 
[*] Fixed bug where a ball hitting a bank right after being hit would fly for ever 
[*] Fixed bug where selecting rehit after hitting from a bunker would allow you to select all shot types
[*] Fixed a bug which caused the ball to roll a bit like an egg on the greens
[*] Fixed a bug whihc caused the ball to rise slightly at the end of its roll
 
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

If you have multiple devices plugged in to your pc each of them is capable of controlling perfect golf. IF you have issues with UI elements changing automatically it is probably because you have another device connected like a wheel that is controlling the UI

At the end of a round the UI Text can become artifacted and will show like a character language.  It will clear up during the next game and can be toggled back by selecting menu items.  this is a unity bug in the current version of unity we are using and will be fixed when we upgrade to Unity 5.2

If a player leaves without disconnecting from the game and the other player is in controller mode only he has no way to get to the settings screen to kick the absent player

Chat will not work when gamepad selected as there is no way to type into chat.

Keyboard/mouse is currently disabled when gamepad selected

notes.title: Perfect Golf 1.3.7.0 Release Today
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the release of ver 1.3.7.0.  This is mainly a bug fixing release as we have been working hard to squash as many of the bugs as we can while also working on getting Course Forge in its final state so we can get a general release out of that in advance of the retail release of the game.  We have got all our new animations done now so we will soon be starting to add them into the game, but that is for a future release.

[h1]New Course[/h1]

We have a new course with this release called Golden Meadows
We have updated all PP Courses for inclusion of Challenge Tees for the new game play mode and made some asthetic changes

A New Version of Willow Heath
 
[h1]New Game Play Modes[/h1]

We have a new game play mode called Skills Challenge Mode which is a series of trouble shots with both a points and distance to the pin scoring system

In addition we have cleaned up the MOP code for Par 3 Challenges so there is a single mop and the holes get auto selected based on Course Selection
 
[h1]New Master Server[/h1]

This brings additional information to the online games including the ability to set an online game to a specific difficulty level.  additional  information includes, game play, mulligans, gimmies, difficulty etc

The new release will not work with the old Master Server so there will be a cut off where players will have to upgrade to be able to join games.
 
[h1]Improvements[/h1]

A whole new Course Selector UI, we figured with the imminent release of a number of user made courses we needed an easier way to navigate through all the courses on the hard drive.  It also comes with a Type Ahead select so you can just type South and it will move to Southampton Links etc.

Added Computer Players:  Please note this is a work in progress, but we wanted you to do a little testing.  Right now we just wanted to get the computer player to a point where they can get around the course.  If they hit into a hazard you will need to manually drop him.  To set a computer player just change the player type in player settings.   The computer player has various settings which allow you to tune his skill.  the higher the skill the longer he will take to make up his mind though.

INITIAL Implementation of Hard and Soft Settings.  We will continue to do some fine tuning on these.  We are still not 100% satisfied with these settings yet but we have pushed them anyway to give you all some additinal variety.

Changed the file format of the MOP files.  Our goal is to provide and online tool to allow users to create MOP files

Added Splash Shot particle effect when in sand and hitting a splash shot.  Note only applies to Splash Shots!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

 
A fix for the latest courses looking all purple and black in the game on a MAC
A fix for the game ending freeze on MAC 
A fix for putting out in the wrong hole, which will now place you within 2 club lengths of the hole and you get to play again... 
A variety of changes to aiming and difficulty.  Most of the bugs Ian reported have hopefully been fixed
Moved the Meter Marks from Difficulty to Settings so people can play the higher settings and still have the marks off
Fixed it so on holes where you may not have passed the fairway aimpoint but are within striking distance of the the green your aim point is the flag
Added the ability to aim with the left and right arrows on the keyboard.
Fixed Alt Shot playing partner ball mark showing from time to time
Fixed Alt Shot Whos up next in Post Shot showing the wrong person
Fixed default game difficulty to Any
Fixes for Stats reporting to server
A variety of fixes to tournament scoring and reporting.  As of right now we think we have fixed every bug in the tournament stuff, but welcome more if you find them
A change to the default scattering off variables to allow for just a little more color in the sky
Some fixes to the who is up next in Post Shot Screen when playing Alt Shot
Minor Hole Physics Tweak
Green Grid now goes all the way to the pin when off the green within 40 yards of the green
Green Grid turns off after shot
New Player General Setting to have auto grid on green
Green Grid - if data point is over the hole it no longer takes account of the hole depth when rendering the grid
Varouis sound fixes, but NOT the one where you hear a pfft and no sounds after that
Added a possible fix for occasional black screen on swing with pause rendering on
Initial fix for mesh trees ball getting stuck in tree, its not perfect yet but a big improvement
Possible fix for top view not staying off
Small physics adjustment to prevent large backwards ball bounces
Small physics fix for dowhhill chip shots
Added some colors to the leaderboard,
Added Colors to the scorecard for birdies, bogeys double bogeys and eagles 
Fixed the thru hole on leaderboard for challenge events
Removed dot in top view when aiming in main view in Pro modes
Removed BLI from main screen when aiming in top view in pro modes
Fixed - If you click F2 during the shot then click on post shot continue you can no longer aim as the game thinks you are in F2 screen
Fixed Water Particle Effect Not Showing
Fixed Player Names going to second line allowing people to hide their true difficulty
Fixed DRV not in bag cheat
Fixed not all difficulty settings transferring over to fixed setting games
Fixed Camera Toggle ("C Key") not sticking when aiming
Fixed Lens Flares not showing
Fixed Alt Shot in Sand have all shot types bug
Fixed Mesh Trees Slider Not Sticking
Fixed As It Lies showing First in Drop Options
Fixed As It Lies not Clearly identified as No Penalty Option
Fixed Bad Drops on Chicago
Fixed Leaderboard button so it will turn red when not available in game
Fixed Putting Follow Cam so ball does not disappear behind golfer
Fixed Having to press C twice to change views
Fixed a bug where if you did not stop the swingmeter on the backspin you got max power.  It now gives you a random amount of overswing
Possible fix for crash when a small motion swing is detected
Fixed On short putts camera does not flip to look at ball
Fixed a bug where grid would come on during a replay if ball landed on green
Made a few minor physics tweaks 

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
Bug where the green grid fails to initialize and the balls roll uphill and stop
Bug where using the space bar to turn off the golfer can have a toggle effect if other golfers are playing locally
Bug where the F4 key can interfere with the follow cam.

[b]With the Physics tweaks we have not had a chance to change all the default distances of all the clubs so user beware.  We will patch this soon[/b]

If there are any major issues please let us know and we will get a patch out as soon as possible

[h1]Future Plans..[/h1]
We are continuing to fine tune tournaments, and will be implmenting the new animations while we continue to get CF reasy for release and fix what we are sure will be additional bugs.

notes.title: Perfect Golf 1.3.4.0 Upcoming Patch
notes.notes:
Right now we are hoping to push another patch to 1.3 (Patch 4) which will have the following fixes in it

[b][u]**WARNING** Users of this patch once downloaded will not be able to connect online with players still using the 1.3.3 Release[/u][/b] 

[h1]Changes to Putting[/h1]
While this release does not represent our final changes to the putting we wanted to get these changes to you.  We have always talked about options and have read all of the feedback.  Without making big changes to the putting for now we hope this release will resolve some of the immediate concerns about the putting

[list]
[*] We have added a new mouse sensitivity setting to the game settings entitled Short Game Sensitivity.  The purpose of this is to allow motion swing users the ability to have less sensitivity of mouse movement when executing short shots or shots that do not need much power.  In conjunction with the Motion Swing Power Bug Fix (see below) we hope this makes putting in motion swing an improved experience
[*] Added a new aid to the player settings menu to enable or disable simplified putting.  When simplified putting is enabled the player will see the old pre 1.3 version of the putting meter with a flag to indicate the strength of the putt required to get the ball to the hole( just beyond) on a flat green with no wind. We hope this gives people the option to play their game and enjoy it whichever swing method people use.
[*] Added an indiator to the multiplayer connection screen showing whether the putting aid is on or off
[*] Extended the slow putting meter to 10 feet from its current 6 feet.  We hope this will provide the click players with an improved putting experience.
[*] Fixed some errors in the naming convention of the putting types while in game
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h1]

Here is a list of the changes in 1.3.4 and bug fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in Motion Swing where the pointer would come back down slightly on the downswing resulting in the player not getting the power setting they were looking for or intended
[*] Added light to top view during darker playing hours to make it easier to make out the different golf course areas
[*] Made some changes to stop follow cam and reverse camera from going underground
[*] Fixes for people experiencing transparancy in some textures or shadows
[*] Fixed bug where sometimes the camera would position itself in a place where you could not see the golfer
[*] Added Club Carry distances to the club selection screen in the Player Settings Menu
[*] Undertook some prep wrok to allow Swing meter to be moved on Screen.  This functionality will become fully functional in a future release
[*] Made some modifications to Driver off the fairway with the goal being to hit it slightly further than the 3W but with a much lower ball flight and longer roll.
[*] Fixes to Willow Heath
[*] Fixes to bulkheads on Shadowlands
[/list]

We hope everyone enjoys the improvements.

notes.title: Perfect Golf 1.3.0.0 Release Notes Part 1
notes.notes:
Many thanks for all your patience while we worked on this upgrade.  We hope we can now resume the more regular update schedule.

[h1] Courses[/h1]
I am sure most of you will be disappointed with the fact that there are no new courses.  We have had to pretty much redo all the courses we had due to the changes in U5.  We have made a commitment to get new courses out to you and we are going to get pushing on this now.  Our goal is to have two more courses to you by the end of next week, one real course and one fictional

[h1]Lighting[/h1]
Improved Lighting and upgrading our Time of Day lighting system. The whole lighting and shader system in U5 is much more immersive and flexible so we have completed a revision of all the settings and data related to the Lighting, shaders and materials inside the game.  Much more dynamic and vibrant should please the folks who complained that it was lacking in contrast
The new trees (more on that later) also take this lighting more effectively adding to the immersion factor.

[h1] Upgrade to Speedtree[/h1]
We have rebuilt our tree library to use SpeedTree which was made available in Unity for the first time in Version 5.  What does this mean, well there are a number of new features in addition to the better lighting

Tree passthrough collisions with a random sound and effect on the ball in flight.  The ball will be slowed down a random amount and deflected a random amount each time it hits the branches or leaves

The tree movement is now tied in to the wind speed so now the higher the wind, the more the trees will move. 
 
 [h1] Upgrade to Physics [/h1]
We have done an Integration of complete skid/slip and roll system into our physics engine bouncing.  This means that spin rate, vertical velocity and softness all determine whether a ball will skid on impact or whether friction with the surface will scrub all the spin off the ball and it will be rolling on impact with the ground. This leads to the ability to hit a much larger variety of shots with more realistic results. 

We have also significantly improved the putting experience. Gone is the flag on the putting meter and instead we have a full putting meter where the player must determine the strength of putt as well as direction.  A full 12 o clock swing will go approximately 70 odd feet and around 30 at the 9 o'clcok.  It is scaled slightly exponentially.  Below the swing meter is an indicator that says whether you are putting inside or outside 6ft.  When inside the swingmeter will move at half pace to make setting short distances much easier and remove the machine gun 3 click effect

We have also fixed the bug that caused the ball to shoot on launching a putt.  the ball will accelerate more quickly downhill and slow down quicker uphill and also take more break.  Everyone will have to learn how to putt all over a gain.

This will make judgement of distance much more difficult and to compensate we have reduced the direction penalty for missing the snap on putts.  There is a new camera for putting you can enable in the game settings UI which is lower to the ground and avoids the issue of the player covering the hole.  In addition when near the green you can hit F4 to view the putt from the far side of the hole.  Hit F4 again to return to the main camera. 
The new bounce physics will also mean people will have to relearn the short game.

Improved the hole cup physics.  Balls will lip out more realisticly now and the ball if hit too hard will hit the back of the cup and bounce upwards a little.  Balls rolling on green will now bounce off the pin if it is in.
   
New Pitch and Lob shot type options remove the need to continually adjust the loft of the shots manually and help to replicate the fine control that the pros display in this part of the game. In conjunction with the new ball and ground physics this allows us to replicate many of the shots you see on the PGA tour week in and week out such as the low pitch shot that grabs and spins itself out near the hole.  As a result we have adjusted the shot center to be for small adjustments only in loft.  With Lob shots the snap penalty has been changed from a directional penalty to more of a Fat Thin penalty.  Snap too early and the ball will not go as far, snap too late and the ball will go too far and lower
 
[h1]Game Play and Stats[/h1]

Added in a handicapping setting into scoring so now you can play net matches against opponents with a defined handicap.  Right now this is on an honor system but eventually it will be integrated into the actual scoring of the player.  This will happen once we get the Perfect Golf Club website and API up and running. 
 
Added in stat tracking so at the end of each round you can see all the players stats and then have your stats for all your players synced with the cloud. The stats can be viewed during the round by viewing the scorecard and clicking the View Stats button in the top left.
 
Added a horizontal swing meter, for those who like to swing left to right or right to left.  You can choose between the two horizontal motion swings by changing your players handedness in the player menu

Restoring offline mode. We have mostly restored the offline mode in the game.  This means we have restored our own networking code for offline play.  You can now play without being connected to the internet or when steam is off and set to offline mode.
 
Online games set up in the lobby can now be protected with a password as can any private chat channels you set up.  To add a password just type a passowrd into the password line when setting up an online game.  All players attempting to join that game will be asked to provide the password. 
 
[h1] Menu Changes[/h1]

[u]Players Menu:[/u]
 - Added a handedness which affects the directionality of the horiontal motion swing
 - Added a handicap value that is used in calculating a players strokes in a new game

[u]Settings Menu - Graphics:[/u]
 - Sun Shafts replaced by God Rays and Lens Flare options.  Lens Flare will work in all modes, God Rays only work when dynamic Sky is on.  If you want lens flares make sure this is set before switching to non dynamic sky
 - Turn Sky Scattering effect on or off - When on the skies will be more blue with less haze,  when off the sky will have a more blue white haze to it
 - Adaptive Lighting.  This feature adds an effect to the camera a little like the pupil of the eye which allows it to show more light when in a dark area and less light when brightly lit
 - Replaced Tree Billboad Slider with new LOD slider for Trees, Higher Values is Higher Tree Quality
 
[u]Weather Settings Menu:[/u]
 - Removed Dust and replaced with Variable which has variable cloudiness on a clear day
 - Changed Storm mode so there is a 50 50 chance of a storm rolling through every 20 mins so not stormy all the time
 - Changed Rain Mode so more of a showers mode.
 - Added Active Weather Slider - This is future functionality and will toggle whether rain causes the ground to soften during game play - For now this button does nothing.

notes.title: Perfect Golf Release 1.2.1.6 Hazards Release Planned for March 25, 2015
notes.notes:
Well here it is.  In this release we will be rolling out full hazard management inside Perfect Golf.  Gone is the Rehit only option replaced with a full suite of drop options implemented in full accordance with the rules of golf.

That means both regular and lateral water hazards with the option to drop on the other side of the hazard when landing in a lateral hazard. 

It also means being able to play the ball as it lies if you are in the hazard but not in the water without a penalty.

Of course rehit remains a viable option for every situation.  

Once you hit into a hazard you will have an option to Rehit/Drop in the post shot screen.  Selecting this button will place you in Drop Mode.  You can cycle through all the drop options to take a look at the lie and position using the left and right arrows on the screen.  At each drop the drop button will tell you the type of drop you are taking (Drop, Rehit, Play it as it Lies).  

While in a particular drop area you will see the area of valid drop defined by an outline color coordinated to the type of hazard.  You can position the ball anywhere inside this area using the aim stick.  Just click inside the area anywhere to move the ball to that position.

When you click inside a hazard drop zone the aimstick will show the distance to the pin so you can position your ball at exactly the yardage you are looking for especially when using the drop in line with the pin option.

Finally of course we now have out of bounds areas and the only drop for out of bounds is a rehit.

We believe that this is a fully comprehensive set of drop options that continues our desire to replicate the game of golf as much as possible.  Some of the logic to determine the appropriate drop zones has been very complex but worth the effort.

There will undoubtedly be some corner cases that you all encounter while playing that we did not discover during testing so please feel free to report them and tell us about them.

There is one known bug which is if you elect to hit the ball from within a hazard and then hit the ball back into the hazard you will be given the option to rehit when in fact this option would not be available to you in real life.

This release does include a few bug fixes listed below

[list]
[*] Improvements to the ball Physics (fixing some issues with last build)
[*] Added in 3 new MOP files which are skins Mops using non progressive skin values.  So the skin options with N are basically $100 per hole and the ones with P are progressive skins like todays skins mode. 
[*] Added the current hole skins value to the hole information when playing Skins
[*] If you play with the tracer turned on it is now automatially removed when putting
[*] Reduced the variability of the wind in all modes, it still changes as often we just reduced the amount it can chage during any single change
[*] Fixed the Heel and Toe display in Practice Mode inside the Swing meter that was incorrectly reporting values 
[*] New Soft Occlusion shaders on the meshes
[*} Updated the sand physics to allow the ball to fall down very steep slopes in the bunkers 
[*} Upgraded Steam Integration to latest API.
[/list]

We know some of you will be disappointed about the fact we have not yet addressed the offline play capability.  We will be getting to this as soon as we have completed the upgrade to U5 along with other items we know have to be fixed, but we wanted to get this last piece of functionality out to you as quickly as possible.  

Thanks again for your support

notes.title: Perfect Golf Update 1.2.1.5 Scheduled for Release March 7th
notes.notes:
This release is a mixture of lots of bug fixes and some new features and plenty of improvements.  Our focus has been to improve game play.  The biggest change will be to the ball roll physics which we have changed to allow for a much larger variety of shots to be hit.  We wanted the low long shot to roll out more and we wanted low hit chip shots to roll out more.  Ultimately we want to get to that bounce bounce grab small release chip shot and will continue to fine tune the physics but this major change will effect how far your balls roll out and will especially affect your chipping distances.  We have changed the chipping distance below the swing meter to act as a guide.  We also wanted to force a full swing to hit a lob shot, a lob chip is not really a real shot so we reduced the amount you can open up the club face of the wedges when chipping

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[list]
[*] New course released Florida Glades
[*] Addition of the Alternate Shot Mops
[*] Added in to Game options Dynamic Cam Option to the Playing Companion Camera so you can now see the ball land when this camera is on
[*] Added in to Game Options a slider to set a timeout for auto closure of the Post Shot Screen.  You can still keep it as manual or you can have it off or a delay in between.
[*] Added an additional audio setting to Audio Options to allow players to set the background course sounds independent of the club and ball impact sounds
[*] Added to Game Options a Green Grid Width Slider to allow you to adjust between 1M and 2M in width depending on your system
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] Some performance improvements some of which are dynamic to reduce low FPS on certain parts of the courses with high draw count
[*] Changes to the BLI color and width
[*] Removed the mouse cursor while the BLI is being moved around to facilitate viewing
[*] Improvements to cup physics and reduced the lip out forces a little
[*] Major upgrade to ground physics allowing for better roll out of the ball when chipping.  You can now effectively play bump and run chip shots.  This is a major change and will mean everyone will have to relearn how to chip the ball.  However it has enabled a whole new range of shots to be hit.  To accommodate the extra roll we reduced the power of the chip swing overall and have replaced all the yardages for chip swings below the meter
[*] Added in a randomization to the lie in the outer rough areas.  Now you can get a little flyer or a tough lie if going into the deep rough. What you get is below the swing meter
[*] Minor network improvements
[*] Improvements to Backspin Physics providing a greater range of backspin results based on actual spin left on ball
[*] Improvements to Wind which mean the ball moves around a little more on lower wind speeds and when hitting into the wind the extra effective ball speed causes side spin to have more effect the same with lift
[*] Minor changes to the swing meter speed in chip mode and max power of the chip swing to accommodate new physics
[*] Made changes to the was anti aliasing affects our rough textures to provide to a less blurry rough and outer terrain
[/list]

[h1] Bug Fixes [/h1]

[list]
[*] Renamed Points to 3 Person Points to make it clear you need 3 people
[*] Fixed a multitude of scoring and game play bugs too numerous to mention individually but includes fixes to scorecard, scoring and playoffs
[*] Fixed Results screen not showing on clients. Note the results screen will only appear when the host closes the scorecard and will disappear when the host closes the results screen causing the game to end.
[*] Fixed the shot center getting reset when the player re aimed his shot
[*] Fixed some errors with Real Time Weather stations not loading correctly
[*] Fixed resolution reset on pushing an update
[*] Added a sort to mop load to ensure everyone sees mops in same order irrespective of file system differences
[*] Fixed need to sometimes have to click Quit twice to end the game
[*] Fixed an overlapping blocker on the Practice Tab
[*] Fixed Anti Aliasing not working when other effects turned off
[*] Fixed Bunker Physics
[*] Fixed bug in punch shot center mode that incorrectly reduced the impact
[*] Fixed an error when hitting lob shots with 52 Wedge
[*] Fixed Pin not showing on Par 3 occasionally
[*] Fixed some UI elements not saving on exit
[*] Fixed ordering of players on tee for some Mops
[*] Fixed a sound issue with ball in rough

[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

There are a couple of items we did not resolve but wanted to get the release out

[list]
[*] Occasionally in Alt Shot modes the next up player in the post shot screen is shown incorrectly
[*] Occasionally a ball will get left on the screen during alt shot 
[*] Resume in alt shot results in each team losing a shot and being placed back where they were before the last shot with the order changed

[/list]

[b][u] Please note we have removed the different sized snap spots on the swing meter.  This does not mean you have lost your aids, we just felt that it was easier to hit the snap with a straight line.  The aids work exactly as before. [/u][/b]

notes.title: Perfect Golf Update 1.2.1.3 Released
notes.notes:
( It may take a while to show in your Steam Client)

We are please to announce the immediate release of update 1.2.1.3

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[u]Introduction of Modes of Play[/u]
Our game play has been converted over to use Mode of Play files which will allow for the customized creation of different game play types.  With over 50 events pre programmed into the game play we will be able tp push out new mop files.  We also plan to create a MOP editor which will allow players to build their own MOPs down the road.

A Mode of Play Guide has been uploaded here http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/manageguide/?id=386429385

[u]Kick and Replace Players[/u]
We have now introduced the capability for the game host to kick players who drop from the game. IF you are in a team based game you cannot kick a player, you must replace the player with one of your players in your player profile.  This will protect the integrity of the game play type while still allowing everyone to continue playing after a player has dropped.  

The host may wish to give the dropping player time to resume his game in case he dropped legitimately from the game

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[u]Networking[/u]
We have made some significant improvements to the network code which should cause you to see some improvements in game play.  We have reduced the amount of network traffic back and firth between the client and the host resulting in quicker packet transition between the two.  

[u]Nat Punch[/u]
We have improved the NAT Punch technology and also added in relay mechanisms where the NAt Punch failed.  This should allow everyone to play online.  The connect time is slightly longer so we added in a connecting symbol so you know something is happening.

[b]PLEASE NOTE!
[olist]
[*]This is an all new Master Server so only updated players games will be visible to you
[*]Please make sure you wait for everyone to complete Loading and be on the tee before starting the round[/b]
[/olist]
[u]Player Information[/u]
We added additional information to the player banners in the top left of the screen including the shot count and the winnings from event based mops

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Fixed excessive release in the bunkers
[*]Fixed animation not rotating at all when slope he was standing on was very steep
[*]Fixed the Stimp Meter value selection in the UI
[*]Fixed shot total for players in the hole
[/list]

Hope your having fun on the fairways!

notes.title: Update Coming Feb 1 / Feb 2
notes.notes:
We had hoped to get an update pushed out today Jan 31st but it seems time has got the better of us.  Not to worry we will get it out tomorrow hopefully, we have been pushing on two major fronts this past week
1) An overhaul of the networking code which will hopefully fix the problems that people were having with the NAT. We have integrated the Steam Networking API which allows us to take advantage of the Steam Relay options when NAT fails so we should be able to have a better multiplayer experience for everyone. This has involved a rewrite of our master server code too and we will run two master servers next week while people update their clients (the old and the new).  
2) The development of a full Mode of Play system.  This will allow us to easily create new game play types.  The update will come with two new modes of play - Matchplay Nassau for those who like matchplay and Hazard Golf for those of you who like a little fun while playing stroke play.  We are also working on the Alternative Shot play format but that will come out in a later update
We have also been working on a number of smaller items, including fixing the stimp setting in the UI, altering the Stimp defaults and range, adding in the number of shots of your competitors on the top left menu, and a fix for the ball roll in the sand.  We are also testing a fix for the excessive roll in the rough.  
Once we get these major pieces done we hope to provide you with more regular but smaller updates, but given how many people said they could not play multiplayer we felt it important to fix this.
 
Thanks for bearing with us, oh and the next update will also have a new course.......
 
PP

notes.title: Perfect Parallel has announced the release of “Perfect Golf", a Golf Simulation Game for PC MAC and Linux on Steam.
notes.notes:
Perfect Parallel today announced that it has released Perfect Golf into Early Access on Steam’s Digitial Distribution Platform.  

Perfect Golf is a new kind of golf simulation that is based on a goal to integrate the real world of golf and the gaming side of golf in a way that has never been done before.  Featuring fully geo referenced golf courses that exist within a real space in the world, Perfect Golf is able to integrate real world data into its virtual worlds.

Perfect Golf features a full real time multiplayer game mode with an integrated lobby inside the game, support for NAT Punchthrough technology, integrated chat and player status in the chat window.  With support for up to 8 players and 4 teams simultaneously it also features a single play, local multiplayer and practice modes with Skins, Match and Stroke gameplay types.

Perfect Golf also features an emergent physics engine which calculates the effects on the ball in real time.  A key component of this is our “live”wind engine with built in elevation coefficient and gust factor which ensures that the wind is varying throughout the 3D environment.

There are 7 different replay cameras and 3 main cameras including a dynamic camera with reverse and landing snap cameras and two different player assists to make the game easier for beginners.

Most importantly Perfect Golf immerses the user in the most photorealistic golf sim available for PC MAC and Linux since golf games migrated from 2D imagery to 3D environments.  A real time weather system tied into the courses geo referenced location and user selected city based weather provides a realistic time of day and lighting environment.

The Early Access version ships with 5 courses and more will be released during Early Access.  Each course is built using our own Course Forge tools which have been adopted by Nicklaus Design as their digital design tool for in house course development (http://www.perfectparallel.com/nicklaus).  We anticipate releasing Course Forge for non commercial use just prior to or along with the full retail release of Perfect Golf.

During Early Access we will be working with the community of adopters to prioritize the new features to be added into the game.  Please come and join us and help make Perfect Golf become the best golf game for PC, MAC and Linux

Buy the game on Steam:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/288140
           
Perfect Parallel is a small independent game development and production company established in 2011.  It focuses on developing sports games and solutions out of real world geo located data.  Perfect Parallel has provided Broadcast Television services during golf tournaments to the PGA Tour, Sky Sports and ESPN.  Perfect Golf is its first gaming title. 

Official website: http://www.perfectparallel.com
